messages.subject: Assistance Needed with m-array for Multinomial CJS Model Incorporating Age and Seasonal Effects
parts:
Hello everyone,

Is there a function similar to "marrayAge" that can create an m-array for capture-resight data while accounting for both age classes and different seasons? I'm currently developing a multinomial CJS model to estimate survival for adults and juveniles across two seasons (winter and spring), but I'm unsure how to incorporate the seasonal components into the m-array. Any advice would be appreciated!


Thank you.


Mercy.
